title: The quick gate is red again in a clean Linux image
what: Make `bin/ci --quick` green in the clean image built from the Containerfile on current master, and keep it green (the gate or a paid step runs it).
why: Found by the remote-gate-host design (30 Oct) while measuring whether a Linux machine would speed up gates. The item the-quick-gate-is-red-in-a-clean-linux-container was closed green on 29 Oct; on master b55c82b9 the Containerfile recipe is red again, so no Linux gate, deciding or comparing, means anything until it is green.
failing_case: 30 Oct, master b55c82b9, podman image built 15 h earlier, `podman run ... bin/ci --quick` from a `--no-hardlinks` clone: 12 failing test batches. Seen: test_paid_batch ("paid-cost: the default branch cannot be told": the clone has no default branch), test_rules_gate_isolation (a ResourceWarning turns into a failure), test_gate_slots test_t4_a_gate_already_waiting_reclaims_* hung 10 min (the image has no lsof: not verified). The run was stopped at 1,272 s.
pass_cases: The same recipe on the fixed head: exit 0, no test hangs.
lsof present in the image or the slot reclaim not needing it on Linux.

fact: Front decision (owner can reverse; principle 1 cheap before expensive): "keep it green" is one step of the paid run (once per wave) running the clean-image quick gate, not a step of every gate: a container quick gate took ~21 min at load 30-43 on this Mac (30 Oct). The VPS Linux watch (item build-time-gates-on-the-vps-landing-gate-on-the) replaces it later. First cycle (30 Oct) ended open 2: no step ran the image, the lock wait in lib/relay_gate.py has no bound without lsof, and the image result was not reproduced.
